mapper.insert: insert into app_user (email, password_hash, display_name, role) values (#{email}, #{passwordHash}, #{displayName}, #{role})
mapper.select: select id, email, password_hash, display_name, avatar_url, cover_url, signature, profile_visibility, show_signature, show_cover, show_email, show_comments, role from app_user where email = #{email}
select id, email, password_hash, display_name, avatar_url, cover_url, signature, profile_visibility, show_signature, show_cover, show_email, show_comments, role from app_user where id = #{id}
mapper.update: update app_user set display_name = #{displayName}, signature = #{signature,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, avatar_url = #{avatarUrl,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, cover_url = #{coverUrl,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, profile_visibility = #{profileVisibility}, show_signature = #{showSignature}, show_cover = #{showCover}, show_email = #{showEmail}, show_comments = #{showComments} where id = #{id}
